proved_scope: Real BitVec 64 payloads inherited from immutable typed binary64 core; no real-valued stand-in for fp64.
Optional fully tagged logical cells; absent or wrong-tag active reads return unavailable, never a default value.
Equal input region names imply complete dtype/tag/payload compatibility at every active index.
runLanes computes/writes each lane in order; all reads use its fixed program-entry snapshot and stores update working memory.
Active defined lanes perform actual logical stores equal to an independent result/reference; masked lanes preserve memory without input/domain constraints.
Complete sequential permutations of range(ceil(N/1024)) succeed and equal the same full reference, with every non-output or output-tail cell preserved exactly.
Zero-length grids, wholly masked programs, missing-input/conversion errors and grid error propagation have explicit lemmas.
All 20 floating-output profiles are total under their chosen callbacks, with no finiteness premise. The 9 integer-output profiles retain defined active conversions.

selected_domain_premises.input_view: Every active input cell has the complete declared tag and word.
selected_domain_premises.output_separation: Both logical input region names differ from the output name; wrapper freshness and physical separation are not proved.
selected_domain_premises.shared_input: Equal input region names require full tagged-cell equality, not only numeric equality.
selected_domain_premises.integer_conversion: OutputDefined requires a successful independent callback result only at active integer-output indices.
selected_domain_premises.program_order: Every permutation of the complete mathematical program list; no native instruction trace/interleaving theorem.

error_model: An Except error contains only a fault and no final memory. This claims no native poison/trap/partial-write/rollback behavior.

numerical_deferrals.status: All unvalidated; concrete queue candidates for parent registration, no accepted numerical experiment.

structural_gaps.detail: The typed AST and memory/grid interpreter are task-local, separate from shared FP.Structural. Inherited raw TTIR route observations do not formally relate the original source/compiler to this interpreter.

Logical memory, masks, stores, frames and complete sequential program permutations are proved. runLanes computes/writes each lane in order with reads from a fixed program-entry snapshot; it does not execute or refine load-all/compute-all/store-all phases, native instruction interleavings or memory races.

structural_gaps.gap: Native storage, finite addresses and memory admission
structural_gaps.detail: String/Nat logical regions and indexed words do not establish physical byte layout/endianness, provenance, allocation extent, native pointer admission, signed i32 pid/offset/mask arithmetic or overflow behavior.

structural_gaps.gap: Wrapper, inactive-lane, errors and host composition
structural_gaps.detail: Output separation is an explicit selected-domain premise, not wrapper freshness or physical nonaliasing. Logical missing-input/undefined-conversion errors return no final memory and prove no native poison, traps, partial-write visibility or rollback. Native masked-load behavior, allocation/device dispatch and Python/Torch module/harness composition remain open.

structural_gaps.gap: Remaining original dtype and error branches
structural_gaps.detail: The 28 semantically promoted fnuz frontend rejection pairs have no successful logical grid; original-program rejection/error contracts are not established by these successful fp64 profiles.
